title: 'He Didn't Have Anything When He Started, But He Persisted': VP Radhakrishnan On ISKCON Founder | India News - News18
text: Vice President CP Radhakrishnan on Wednesday released the much-anticipated book Sing, Dance and Lead: Leadership Lessons from the Life of Srila Prabhupada at an event held at the Vice President’s Enclave, New Delhi. The launch ceremony was attended by a distinguished gathering of public figures, diplomats, academicians and senior Government of India officials. The book, authored by noted historian Dr Hindol Sengupta, explores the extraordinary life and leadership journey of Srila Prabhupada, the founder of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness (ISKCON). Sengupta presents Prabhupada not merely as a spiritual leader but as a “spiritual entrepreneur" whose vision and resilience helped establish a global cultural and spiritual movement. In his address, Vice President Radhakrishnan spoke about the depth of the lessons embedded in Prabhupada’s life. “He didn’t have anything when he started, but he still persisted," he said, recalling Prabhupada’s decision at age 70 to embark on an arduous journey from Kolkata to the United States to spread Krishna consciousness. Emphasising the relevance of such leadership for contemporary times, Radhakrishnan noted, “Leadership is not about authority but about conviction, service and clarity of vision." He highlighted that Prabhupada’s inclusive approach underscores how leadership can be joyful, participative and deeply human. The Vice President also connected the themes of the book with broader democratic values. Drawing from his speech on democratic governance, he stressed that “democratic institutions thrive on trust, not procedure alone," underscoring the need for empathy, moral clarity and public trust in strengthening India’s democratic fabric. Union Minister for Culture and Tourism Gajendra Singh Shekhawat, who was present at the occasion as Guest of Honour, commented that Prabhupada’s journey teaches “how depth creates durability," valuing long-term purpose over short-term visibility. Also present were Dr D R Kaarthikeyan, former Director General of the CBI; foreign ambassadors; the Vice Chancellor of OP Jindal University; and senior officials of the Government of India, making it a pan-institutional event reflecting on leadership, culture and service. Chanchalapati Dasa, Vice Chairman of the Global Hare Krishna Movement, reflected on the unique lens the book brings to Prabhupada’s accomplishments, saying that this work “explores and celebrates another aspect of his personality." Sing, Dance and Lead is positioned not only as a biography but as a leadership manual for the modern era — blending spiritual wisdom with practical insights, and inspiring readers to rethink leadership as a means to uplift society at large.
